experiment: Counterbalanced month codewords, native capability first then L29 T2375 natural-contribution removal
design: All twenty revised fifth/twelfth-word requests are retained: five word orders x two formats x two requested positions. No selection on steering outputs.

At the two frozen chat-prefix newline positions, replace the post-JumpReLU scalar with a fixed target from 2,5,10,20,40. This is absolute scalar replacement, not multiplication and not copying a donor operator.

Add (target - natural_gate) * ((z @ V @ U) * output_std) at each selected input position. z is the recipient residual standardized before the native post-attention RMSNorm. Native MLPs and attention remain intact.
Only those two input tokens are edited. All other input positions, including the numbered-list newline before printed 11., and all generated/candidate-scoring positions remain unedited.
Use native and zero-strength edit runs as exact replay controls against saved baseline outputs, selected probabilities, every decoding-logit hash, and terminal unused-logit hash.
Score canonical complete lowercase words at positions 5,11,12 by cached teacher forcing; retain both word-only and word-then-EOS probabilities.

Two baseline twelfth-word cases already return the eleventh word. Show but never count those as newly induced successes. Retain other baseline failures, full high-gain outputs, truncations and formatting failures.
Report strict EOS-terminated word-only eleventh answers separately from merely mentioning that word; no incomplete or incoherent high-gain response counts as a strict success.
Report native requested-word competence and the saved native eleventh-word question control per case.

scopes.off-is: Query-final space+is only; identical to final supplied token in raw completion.
scopes.off-last: Final supplied chat-prefix token only (chat cases).
scopes.off-all: Every supplied input token, including codebook/query/wrappers. No generated-token edits.

eligibility: A mapping/format is eligible only if native eleventh and twelfth responses both equal their codewords after whitespace, case, quote/markdown wrapper and terminal .!? normalization. No selection based on ablation outcomes. Retain all failed pairs and do not interpret their missing ablations as negative effects.
probabilities: For each target code/month, sum the probabilities of four disjoint exact output-token prefixes: lowercase/titlecase with zero/one leading space, deduplicated by token sequence. Preserve full multi-token scores and separate word-plus-EOS scores. Tokenization of each candidate is fixed independently as an output continuation; input tokens are never retokenized.
baseline_order: Run native and zero/observer for every case, freeze baseline results and eligibility before any nonzero edit.
intervention: Native L29 MLP output minus natural T2375 gate times local UVx in native output units, FP32 subtraction then one BF16 cast; all native later layers retained. No full MOLT MLP replacement.
controls: Plain eleventh/twelfth raw completions as calibration. Native vs zero exact. No claims of feature specificity without separate matched-active-transform controls; not included in this pilot.
